import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Force checkout main
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git checkout -f main 2>&1 | tail -2")
print("Checkout:", stdout.read().decode())
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git log -1 --oneline 2>&1")
print("Commit:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
